text:
sara_sales: Quick sync — Maelstrom wants to onboard a custom 30B variant for their edge POC. Key asks: KV cache compatibility, quantized 8-bit variant, customer-managed KMS, and pricing delta. Can we get a checklist + blockers? cc @jia_ml_eng @omar_infra @linda_se

jia_ml_eng: Looked at their model spec — it's a 30B fork using rotary embeddings + RMSNorm. Good news: runtime supports it but we need a small shim to map LayerNorm->RMSNorm for some kernels. No full retrain required. Expect ~10-15% latency increase at 8k context when running quantized 8-bit.

omar_infra: KV cache layout is compatible but the rotary implementation increases per-token KV state a bit. Estimate ~12% more KV memory on our standard shard layout. Recommend increasing KV cache budget in the Dedicated pool config. Also autoscale tweak: raise concurrency_threshold and max_batch_tokens. KMS: AWS-CMK (customer-managed) is supported; will need their key ARN and account IAM cross-account setup.

linda_se: Security flags from the initial questionnaire: data residency, model provenance, license for hosted inference, and encryption-at-rest keys. We'll need: model provenance doc (commit hash + training data summary), signed DPA, and confirmation of license (no restrictions on hosted inference). I'll start a checklist and ping legal.

sara_sales: Two sales follow-ups — 1) can we do a canary rollout that falls back to a smaller model if latency or error rate spikes? 2) rough pricing delta for Hosted API vs Dedicated reserved for their quantized variant (ballpark, to quote customer).

jia_ml_eng: Canary is supported via rollout config. Suggested: canary traffic=10% for 24h, health checks: p95 latency and error-rate <1%. Fallback policy -> smaller 13B variant. Pricing: rough estimates until pricing team confirms — Hosted per-token for quantized 30B ~ +25% over our 13B baseline due to increased tokens and latency. Dedicated reserved (monthly commit) — you can usually get an amortized uplift of ~18-22% compared to hosted list, depending on commit level and burst allowances. I'll confirm with pricing.

omar_infra: I'll draft an infra-runbook snippet and the KMS onboarding steps. Need the customer's model artifact (S3 URL or OCI registry) and a sample model config (model.yaml) that includes tokenizer type and rotary params. Example autoscale snippet we recommend:

```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  max_replicas: 10
  max_batch_tokens: 8192
  concurrency_threshold: 48
```

linda_se: I'll pull their license and start the DPA. Also requesting SOC2 snapshot and any compliance attestation if they want Private deployment. Please capture customer legal contact.

sara_sales: I'll ask for S3 artifact + model config + license + legal contact and ask ops to accept canary flow. Also confirm embedding requirement — they mentioned embeddings for search.

jia_ml_eng: The variant doesn't have a dedicated embeddings head by default. Options: 1) small finetune to add an embedding head (~a few hours) — best quality for production; 2) derive embeddings via prompt-based pooling (faster, lower quality). Recommend option 1 for POC-probative search UX.

sara_sales: Great — assigning tasks: @omar_infra to draft runbook/KMS steps, @linda_se to start legal/DPA, @jia_ml_eng to validate perf numbers and confirm pricing with pricing team. I'll request artifacts from customer and share here when available. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sec-bot: Security checklist created: https://redwood.internal/checklists/maelstrom-poc (added data-residency, dpa-required, license-check).

sara_sales: Saved — will follow up once I have artifacts.
